steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Common separable prefixes: an-, aus-, auf-, ein-, mit-, nach-, vor-, zu-, zurück-, zusammen-, weg-. In subordinate clauses, the prefix stays attached: "...weil ich um 8 Uhr anfange" (NOT anfange ich). | Exam Tip: "Ich möchte" is technically the subjunctive of mögen but functions as a modal verb. It is the standard way to express "I would like" in German. Note: ich kann, ich muss, ich darf, ich will, ich soll — these all have NO -e ending in the ich form. | German Exam Tips — Separable and Modal Verbs: 1. For Separable and Modal Verbs, use a range of vocabulary and complex grammatical structures to access higher marks 2. Check verb tenses, agreements and word order carefully in your written work 3.
